claims.statement: A fragment can preserve declared work and edition identity while explicitly remaining less than the whole book.
Local unavailability can be represented without asserting global nonexistence.
The specimen can be published on ordinary HTTPS with independently addressable human and machine carriers.
An independent live-browser reader starting only from the public llms.txt can enter a non-first fragment and preserve identity, uncertainty, continuation, and no-authority state.
The format is a universal standard for computer-native literature.
